name: HYDRA-UMC-DOCS-QA
notes: Real v0 lexical retrieval: stdlib-only TF-IDF search (query subcommand) over ingested Markdown, defaulting to this repo's own README/CHANGELOG. Deterministic scoring (hash-seed-independent summation), traceable source#index citations, and a real document allowlist (only existing .md/.markdown paths are ingested; every other path is rejected with a distinct reason instead of being silently skipped or silently read as text). Honestly lexical, not yet embedding-based semantic search, and no LLM synthesis step - that and PDF ingestion are future work.
